title: agent-sync project configuration
description: Shape only. Identity (instance URL, token, container id) lives in .env.agent-sync and is never committed.

backend.description: Which adapter holds coordination state. 'fs' is degraded: not the lease authority across machines.

gated.description: Whether runs may be reported as enforced. Effective only when the backend is the lease authority.

idRegisters.description: Registers whose next free id must be reserved before it is written to git. Needs an allocator: leaseBackend 'git' (ids from refs/agent-sync/ids/* at the remote, whatever the backend) or a backend that orders writes (outline, notion). `check` refuses registers that neither serves.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the register file.

nextFreeIdPattern.description: Regex with one capture group holding the next free number.

guardedFiles.description: Glob patterns that require a live lease before being written. A submodule lists only its own registers; cross-repository files belong to the parent repository.

claimTags.description: How a lease is written through to the roadmap. See references/roadmap.md.

mode.description: 'cell' edits one cell of the single table row containing the task id.

cell.description: 0-based cell index in that row; negative counts from the end.

held.description: Template for the held value. {prev} is the current cell text, {holder} the run id.

gates.description: Shell commands run at the pipeline's lint stage; each result is journaled.

sources.description: Files or directories rendered one-way into the knowledge store, stamped with the source commit.

setupFile.description: Where the generated setup snapshot is written. Defaults to docs/AGENT_SYNC.md when docs/ exists, else AGENT_SYNC.md.

leaseBackend.description: Where a contended lease is decided. 'local' is an atomic file create — exclusive between processes on one filesystem. 'git' pushes a ref, and the remote's non-fast-forward rule is a real compare-and-swap, exclusive across machines.

leaseRemote.description: Git remote holding the lease refs when leaseBackend is 'git'.

settleSeconds.description: Unused by the git and local backends; retained for adapters that must wait for writes to become visible.

integrationBranch.description: The branch work lands on. Claims are written through only there; on any other branch the holder lives in the coordination plane until `merge`. Default: the repository's own default branch.

mergeLog.description: The record of what landed on the integration branch, written by `merge`.

file.description: Path to the log, relative to the repository root. Default docs/MERGES.md.

retentionDays.description: How many days keep full detail; older entries are compacted to one line on the next write. Default 7.
